# UnclaimedSOL

UnclaimedSOL helps Solana users and agents scan and reclaim dormant SOL. Unclaimed SOL MCP is the first Vibe Claiming MCP server for AI agents and assistants.

## MCP server

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@unclaimed-sol/mcp
- Run: `npx -y @unclaimed-sol/mcp`
- GitHub: https://github.com/unclaimed-sol/unclaimed-sol-mcp
- Tools: `scan_claimable_sol`, `claim_sol`, `claim_rewards`, `claim_stakes`
- Flow: run `dry_run` to preview, then execute with the returned 60s `execution_token`

## Web app

- Website: https://unclaimedsol.com
- Use the web app for browser-based wallet scans and claims.

## Fees

- Scanning: free
- Token cleanup: user keeps up to 0.002 SOL per closed account
- Program buffers: 5%
- DeFi rewards: 15% general
- Pump/PumpSwap rewards: 3%, capped at 1 SOL / 100 USDC
- Deactivated stakes: 3%
- Collection: on-chain; no funds pass through the MCP server

## Security

- Security model: https://github.com/unclaimed-sol/unclaimed-sol-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Signing is local.
- The keypair never leaves the user's machine.
- No seed phrase is requested or accepted.
